sources.observation: Two red-roofed sandstone wings and clock towers flank a long curved colonnade over the south-facing terraces.

sources.credit: Portiatn / Wikimedia Commons, see image page
sources.observation: The western clock tower has an open belfry, a sandstone dome and an elevated lantern above the wall clock.

limitations: Intermediate roof forms, terrace heights, window intervals, stone carving and the tower lanterns are interpreted from exterior photography. The lower public garden is retained as host terrain.
